title: Rhyhorn Forgets Why It Charges
premise: Rhyhorn begins a charge with a purpose, then forgets that purpose while its body keeps rushing forward.
audiencePromise: See how Rhyhorn’s memory, short legs, and unstoppable charge turn one flaw into its defining identity.
openLoop: If Rhyhorn forgets the goal, what keeps it charging?
payoff: Rhyhorn forgets why it started, but its unstoppable charge may be the clearest thing about it.
engagementQuestion: Is forgetting the goal a flaw, or Rhyhorn’s whole identity?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly and warmly, with playful disbelief. Stress forgets, straight, and identity. Pause briefly before the final either-or question.

scenes.headline: THE CHARGE FORGETS ITS GOAL
scenes.narration: Rhyhorn forgets why it started charging.
scenes.caption: THE GOAL VANISHES MID-CHARGE

scenes.headline: ONE THING AT A TIME
scenes.narration: Its memory holds one thing, so the charge erases its goal.
scenes.caption: ONE THOUGHT IN. THE MISSION OUT.

scenes.headline: NO TURNS. JUST FORWARD.
scenes.narration: Short legs cannot turn well, leaving one straight path forward.
scenes.caption: THE ROUTE SHRINKS TO ONE DIRECTION

scenes.headline: THE BODY KEEPS GOING
scenes.narration: And once it starts, Rhyhorn keeps running until it falls asleep.
scenes.caption: THE PURPOSE IS GONE. THE CHARGE ISN'T.

scenes.headline: IMPACT MAY RESET IT
scenes.narration: Sometimes, smashing something apparently helps it remember why it started.
scenes.caption: DESTRUCTION MAY BRING THE MEMORY BACK

scenes.headline: FORGETFUL. UNSTOPPABLE. RHYHORN.
scenes.narration: Goal forgotten. Charge intact. Flaw or identity?
scenes.caption: WHAT DO YOU CALL THIS KIND OF FOCUS?
